summary: Steel Aermotor tower on Cedar Mountain near Leetonia, Tioga County; built 1928, removed 1986; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1986; no source describes what remains on the site.

corrections.why: The record holds a fragment of a 1939 newspaper quote, not an agency name; the sources read name no agency

sources.title: Lee Tower Site | Former Fire Lookout Sites

notes_for_editor: Two thin sources, both transcribed histories; no source describes the site today and access is unknown, so no access facts are recorded. Brief height 24.4 m agrees with the 80-foot figure in the 1939 report. The 1939 and 1949 articles are quoted second-hand on the weebly page. A 2025 Tioga State Forest map sheet uses the quadrangle name Lee Fire Tower but shows no structure, so it was not used. The brief agency value was a quote fragment and is proposed for correction.
